durable_state_changes: none (no schema, migration, table, or backend change)

feedback.headings: one no-priority result heading; 'Suggested Next Step' exactly once (action block uses 'Choose your next step'); neutral passage heading 'Passage From Your Writing' when the diagnosis has no structured strength (no unsupported Strength label)
feedback.rerun_safety: buttons only act on click; reruns render state without triggering actions

home.after_finish: returns to the normal durable-state contract (no unresolved block)
home.after_revise: revision-writing step becomes the current goal via the existing revision mode
home.unresolved_block: while submission_result is an unresolved no-priority result: Latest submission #N + 'No automatic priority selected' + 'Review the result and choose whether to revise or finish the cycle' + the two action controls

feedback_actions.semantics: Revise This Draft: preserves the current submission as the revision source, enters the existing Writing revision mode (writing_task_relationship + writing_revision_source_preset), releases the saved-submission panel, no automatic priority fabricated

Finish This Feedback Cycle: acknowledges the reviewed no-priority result (session flag no_priority_reviewed), clears the stale submission_result, navigates to a fresh Writing state; never deletes Submission #28, never creates a revision or practice target

no_priority_branch.valid_result: no-priority remains a valid Diagnostic Gate result (No sufficiently supported automatic revision priority was identified)

practice.skipped_state: when no practice target exists after a finished no-priority cycle: reason explained ('No practice target was created because no automatic revision priority was selected'), actionable Writing route; no arbitrary content

revision.no_auto_focus: info message when the selected source feedback has no priority; source identity preserved; revision-writing action available without a practice target

writing.after_finish: fresh form; stale 'Writing submitted' panel and Review Feedback loop absent; cycle-finished acknowledgement notice shown once
writing.revision_mode: preset source preserved and pre-selected; no automatic priority required
